issue.detail: Spec does not define whether a 1-to-0 transition spanning a reset cycle is captured. Contract updates prev_in during reset, so a reset-cycle 1 followed by post-release 0 captures out=1; the falling-edge rule only states prev_in update when reset==0, leaving reset-cycle history inconsistent.
issue.spec_evidence: "Capture" means that the output will remain 1 until the register is reset (active high synchronous reset).
issue.alternative: Reset clears/suppresses prev_in history, so a 1 sampled during reset followed by 0 after reset release is not captured.
